title: Greek Loukoumades with Fresh Banana
description: A traditional Greek dessert featuring crispy loukoumades topped with sweet fresh banana and a drizzle of honey.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add in water, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Heat unique oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of batter into the hot oil.
Fry loukoumades for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain excess oil on paper towels.
In a separate bowl, mash ripe banana until smooth.
Drizzle honey over the top of the fried loukoumades.
Serve immediately, topped with fresh banana mash.
